info.name: CS 313 Week 12 - Shinobi Quiz Battle
info.description: Log in folder runs first, followed by authentication and account checks, then the Week 11 API checks. All protected calls use JWT bearer tokens.

exec: pm.test('duplicate school ID returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

item.name: Register role ADMIN is still PLAYER

exec: pm.test('role spoofing registration returns 201 as PLAYER', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

item.name: Unknown school ID has same 401 body

exec: pm.test('unknown school ID returns the same 401 response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('invalidCredentialsBody')); });
pm.test('/auth/me returns the authenticated user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: GET auth me without token returns 401

exec: pm.test('/auth/me without a token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: GET auth me with tampered token returns 401

exec: pm.test('/auth/me with a tampered token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: GET auth me with X-Demo-User only returns 401

exec: pm.test('legacy demo-user header is not authentication', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('player cannot list accounts', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('admin can list accounts', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('admin promotes a player', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql('HOST'); });
